# Glossary

Full terminology reference for Braze documentation. Extracted from the Braze
Customer Education Style Guide v2.

Legend: (caution) = use carefully, (banned) = do not use.

## A

- **A/B testing**
- (caution) **abort** — Avoid unless referring to a named process. Use "stop", "exit", "cancel", or "end".
- **action-based delivery** — Lowercase unless matching a capitalized UI element.
- (banned) **ad hoc** — Use "one-time" or similar.
- **AI item recommendation**
- **Alloys / Braze Alloys** — Always capitalized.
- **alphanumeric** — No hyphen.
- (banned) **app group** — Use "workspace".

## B

- **beta**
- **boolean**
- (banned) **blacklist** — Use "blocklist" or "denylist". Reword to avoid verb form.
- **Braze-to-Braze webhook**

## C

- **California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)** — Spell out first mention.
- **can** — Use for optional actions. Don't use for directions; prefer imperative verbs.
- **Canvas** — Always capitalized. Plural: Canvases.
- **Canvas Flow** — Use only when differentiating from original editor.
- **campaign** — Lowercase in running text (`create a campaign`, `active campaigns`). Capitalize only when matching a capitalized UI label (for example, the **Campaigns** page). Never mid-sentence **Campaign** / **Campaigns** for the product concept.
- **capacity** — Use instead of "limit" for custom data constraints.
- **catalog** — Lowercase in running text unless matching a capitalized UI label.
- **Content Blocks** — Title case.
- **Currents / Braze Currents** — Always capitalized.
- **custom attributes** — Lowercase unless matching UI.
- **custom events** — Lowercase unless matching UI.

## D

- **dashboard / Braze dashboard** — Lowercase "dashboard".
- **drag and drop** (verb) / **drag-and-drop** (adjective)
- **Drag-And-Drop Editor** — Title case for the feature name.

## E

- **early access**
- (banned) **e.g.** — Use "for example", "such as", or "like".
- **eCommerce** — Not "ecommerce" or "e-commerce".
- **email** — Not "Email" or "e-mail".
- **end user** (noun) / **end-user** (adjective) — Prefer "your users".
- (caution) **ensure** — Avoid for feature descriptions. See "Avoid Guarantees".
- **external ID** — Lowercase. In code: `external_id`.

## F–G

- **Fullscreen** — No hyphen as adjective.
- **GitHub** — Not "Github".

## I

- (banned) **i.e.** — Use "that is" or similar.
- **Intelligence Suite** — Title case.
- **Intelligent Channel / Selection / Timing** — Title case.

## K–L

- (caution) **kill** — Use "stop", "exit", "cancel", or "end".
- **Liquid** — Always capitalized.

## M–N

- **maximum** — Not "max".
- **media library** — Lowercase unless matching UI.
- **multichannel campaign** — No hyphen. Lowercase unless matching UI.
- **N/A** — Not "NA". In inline text, spell out "not available" or "not applicable".
- (caution) **new** — Avoid in product docs; quickly dates content.

## O

- **once** — Use for single-time actions. Don't use in place of "after".
- (banned) **out-of-the-box** — Use "default".

## P

- **Personalized Path / Variant** — Title case.
- **Predictive Churn / Events / Purchases / Suite** — Title case (product names).
- **preference center** — Lowercase unless matching UI.
- **promotion code** — Not "promo code". Lowercase unless matching UI.

## Q

- (banned) **QA** as verb — Use "perform quality assurance".
- **Quiet Hours** — Title case.
- (caution) **quick / quickly** — Avoid; may feel condescending.

## R

- **re-engagement**
- (caution) **regular expression / regex** — Prefer spelled-out form. Not "RegEx".

## S

- (banned) **sanity check** — Use "quick check" or "preliminary check".
- **scheduled delivery** — Lowercase unless matching UI.
- **Segment** (partner) — Capitalized. **segment** (audience) — lowercase in running text (`create a segment`). Capitalize only when matching a capitalized UI label (for example, the **Segments** page) or the Segment partner name.
- **Segment Extensions / Insights** — Title case.
- **SQL Segment Extensions** — Title case.

## T–U

- (caution) **terminate** — Use "stop", "exit", "cancel", or "end".
- **time zone** — Not "timezone".
- (banned) **unzip** — Use "extract".
- **URL** — All caps. "a URL" not "an URL". Plural: URLs.
- (caution) **utilize** — Use "use" unless referring to repurposing beyond original intent.

## V

- (banned) **via** — Use "through", "by means of", or "by way of".
- (banned) **vice versa** — Use "conversely" or "the other way around".
- (caution) **vs.** — Spell out "versus".

## W

- **webhook**
- (banned) **whitelist** — Use "allowlist" or "safelist" unless matching UI.
- **Wi-Fi** — Not "WiFi", "wi-fi", or "wifi".
- **will** — Avoid. Use present tense.
- **Winning Path / Variant** — Title case.
- (banned) **wizard** — Use "composer".
- **workspace** — Lowercase. Replaced "app group".

## Y–Z

- **YAML** — Use "YAML file" not ".yaml file".
- **YouTube** — Intercap.
